company.description: Decawork provides software for IT teams to deploy, govern, and maintain internal AI agents. The platform gives each agent a separate identity and scoped credentials, with IT approval required before deployment. It routes tool calls through a governed gateway, records and attributes actions, and supports approval workflows for sensitive operations. Decawork also monitors agent runs, alerts IT when credentials or integrations fail, and enables teams to pause, restore, or retire agents. The service supports agents built with Claude Code, Codex, or other technology stacks.

productsAndServices.description: A software control plane for deploying, governing, monitoring, and maintaining AI agents used by IT teams.
